title: HB1207 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to suicide prevention.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2025-02-06; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 3105750)
provenance.note: Draft (as filed) dated 2025-02-06; summary says "As introduced", no passage vote listed, so no adopted amendments are missing. "Suicide Prevention Act of 2025". Twin document HB1207/SB1094 (SB1094); SB1094 text was copied from the HB1207 file. Section 3 adds a new item to the list of persons dealers must refuse.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (new TCA 39-17-1367(a)(1)): In an effort to prevent violence, including suicide, homicide, or mass shooting by persons with mental illness using firearms, the Tennessee bureau of investigation (TBI) shall establish a program for revocable voluntary waiver of firearms rights so as to avoid purchase, possession, and transportation of firearms by and sale of firearms to:
SECTION 2 (new TCA 39-17-1367(a)(5)(B)): Upon receipt of the form, the department of safety must revoke the person's handgun carry permit under § 39-17-1351 and § 39-17-1366.
SECTION 2 (new TCA 39-17-1367(f)): It is an offense for a person who is enrolled in the revocable voluntary waiver of firearms rights program to purchase, possess, or transport a firearm.
SECTION 2 (new TCA 39-17-1367(f)): A violation of this subsection (f) is a Class C misdemeanor.
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1316(a)(1)(A)): (vi) Are enrolled in the revocable voluntary waiver of firearms rights program pursuant to § 39-17-1367.
